title: Nanoscale and Single-Dot Patterning of Colloidal Quantum Dots

source_inventory.title: Nanoscale and Single-Dot Patterning of Colloidal Quantum Dots
source_inventory.scope: All seven main and eight eligible SI pages: pre-existing CdSe/CdS inputs, lithographic patterning and lift-off procedures, distinct measured pattern families and statistical model contexts. No complete QD growth recipe or exact atomistic coordinates are supplied.
source_conflicts: Figure 4b prints the 38.0 nm cohort means as fit 2.079 and experimental 2.333, while the prose describes mean discrepancies as less than 10%. The exact numbers and prose are both retained. Dividing their absolute difference by either displayed mean does not yield less than 10%; the source does not specify its discrepancy definition.
Caption explicitly includes 22 nm, while prose says thicker than 22 nm for eliminating residues; the separately stated empirical threshold is approximately 20 nm.
limitations: Patterned-film preparation assembles pre-existing CdSe/CdS QDs; cited upstream QD synthesis is not imported.
Missing operational values and exact physical batch joins remain unassigned.
Statistical models and source calculations remain distinct from measured specimens.
Source figure reuse permission is unverified.
